tools.name: check_company_status
tools.description: Use this when checking a Czech company by its 8-digit IČO for registry status, insolvency, VAT reliability, officers, or disclosed shareholders. Public registries only; 1 credit. Do not use for natural-person screening, legal advice, or a trustworthiness verdict.

tools.name: get_evidence
tools.description: Use this when you need source evidence, acquisition times, or coverage for a Czech company by 8-digit IČO. Public registries; authorized audits may add financial evidence. 1 credit. Do not use missing evidence as proof of absence, screen natural persons, or give legal advice.

tools.name: lookup_company
tools.description: Use this when you need a full normalized profile of one Czech company by 8-digit IČO. Public registries only; 1 credit. Do not use for name search, natural-person screening, or legal advice.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Use this when searching Czech companies by name, IČO, region, industry, year, or status with pagination. Public registries only; 1 credit per call. Do not use for a known 8-digit IČO profile, natural-person screening, or legal advice.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Use this when finding Czech companies by name or 8-digit IČO before fetching one result. Public registries only; anonymous discovery is free, signed-in calls cost 1 credit. Do not use for natural-person screening or legal advice.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Use this when reading one Czech company found by search using company:<8-digit IČO>; signed-in clients may also use its profile URL. Public registries only; anonymous preview is free, signed-in calls cost 1 credit. Do not use for natural-person screening or legal advice.

tools.name: get_relationships
tools.description: Use this when exploring documented relationships of a Czech company by 8-digit IČO: depth 0 costs 1 credit; graph depth 1–3 costs 2/5/15 credits. Public registry links may be incomplete. Do not use to infer beneficial ownership, screen natural persons, or give legal advice.

tools.name: find_path
tools.description: Use this when finding a documented graph path between Czech registry entities; company seeds use 8-digit IČO. Public registry data; depth-scaled cost is 2/5/15 credits. Do not use a path as proof of control, for natural-person screening, or for legal advice.

tools.name: list_top_in_industry
tools.description: Use this when listing ranked Czech companies in a known industry slug. Company profiles use 8-digit IČO; public registry data; 1 credit per page. Do not use as a complete market census, natural-person screening, or legal advice.

tools.name: get_changes
tools.description: Use this when reading changes for Czech companies on your own watchlist, optionally filtered by 8-digit IČO. Registry-derived records; 1 credit per call. Do not use for another account’s watchlist, natural-person screening, or legal advice.

tools.name: screen_companies_by_thesis
tools.description: Use this when screening Czech companies against an investment, supplier, compliance, or sales thesis. Public registry data and 8-digit IČO identifiers; 1 credit. Do not use rankings as due diligence, for natural-person screening, or for legal advice.

tools.name: score_company_for_use_case
tools.description: Use this when scoring one Czech company by 8-digit IČO for a stated use case and reading documented finance or sector signals. Registry sources and authorized audit data when available; 1 credit. Do not use as a credit decision, natural-person screening, or legal advice.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
